description: Defines an immutable class MergedJsonObjectMap that merges two JSON objects and presents them as a Map<String, JsonValue>. Implements methods for size, containment, retrieval, and iteration over keys, values, and entries, with support for merging fallback JSON objects.

classes.name: MergedJsonObjectMap
classes.description: An immutable class that merges two JSON objects and exposes them as a Map<String, JsonValue>.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a MergedJsonObjectMap from two JsonObjects.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a MergedJsonObjectMap from a Map<String, JsonValue>, converting it into JSON fields.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the merged map.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if both JSON objects are empty.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in either JSON object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key from the merged JSON objects.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns a set of all keys from both JSON objects.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a collection of all values from both JSON objects.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns a set of all entries (key-value pairs) from both JSON objects.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on underlying JSON objects.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on underlying JSON objects.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object.
